text:
Asha (CS): Hey team - request from Cloudwell: they'd like an evening "onboarding + Dedicated handoff" workshop next Wed. Prefer 17:30 CET to hit APAC late afternoon. Need: facilitator, runbook publisher, recording owner, 4 hands-on lab seats.
Tom (CS): I can facilitate but prefer we keep it 75m if we do hands-on. Also want a short pre-read for attendees.
Ellen (EMEA CS): 17:30 CET is 22:30 SGT, borderline. 17:00 CET would be better for APAC. Could we do 17:00-18:15 instead?
Ravi (CS Ops): I can provision labs and publish runbook. Will request 4 lab seats from eng-ops and create RSVP. Need final time to reserve Dedicated pool.
Diego (Solutions): I'll do the migration demo and can prep a minimal dataset. Happy to pair with Tom for live Q&A.
scheduler-bot: Tip: use /reserve-dedicated --slots 4 --duration 2h to request pool.
Asha (CS): Good point Ellen; let's aim 17:00 CET. Tom - 75m works (45 demo+lab + 30 Q&A/feedback). Can you draft a compact agenda?
Tom (CS): Draft agenda below:

---
Title: Cloudwell onboarding + Dedicated Handoff (Redwood)
When: Wed [date] 17:00 CET 18:15 CET (75m)
Agenda:
- 00:00-00:10 Welcome & goals (Asha)
- 00:10-00:40 Migration demo & config checklist (Diego)
- 00:40-01:10 Hands-on lab (4 seats - pre-provisioned)
- 01:10-01:15 Quick feedback poll + next steps
Notes: Recording on; RSVP required for lab. Pre-read: 1-page migration checklist.
---

Tom (CS): Lab invite command (Ravi):
```
reserve-lab --customer cloudwell --seats 4 --expires 48h
```

Ravi (CS Ops): Running reserve now. Also filing a Dedicated pool request. Will post RSVP link when done.
Ellen (EMEA CS): I'll own recording start/stop and capture any renewal-risk flags during session. If migration blockers appear we'll mark account health as "at-risk" and notify AM.
Diego (Solutions): I'll upload slides by Tue EOD. Can someone review Wed morning?
Asha (CS): I can review Tue night (US friendly). Also will build the post-session feedback form (3 quick questions + NPS).
Tom (CS): I'll post a 1-question poll in #customer-success to confirm attendee preference for Wed vs Thu in case we need to nudge.
Ravi (CS Ops): RSVP link created: https://cal.example.com/cloudwell-onboard (placeholder). Dedicated pool request submitted to eng-ops.
scheduler-bot: Event created: Cloudwell onboarding + Dedicated Handoff 17:00 CET (recording enabled).
Asha (CS): Great. Plan: 17:00 CET, 75m, recording on, 4 lab seats, pre-read + feedback form. After event Ravi will publish recording and runbook; I'll log any renewal signals. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
